murion.name: Murion
murion.summary:
Archmage, Prima of House Bonisagus, leader of Durenmar, leader of the Oak Gild and, as holder of Bonisagus's sigil, Praeco of the Rhine Tribunal: the most politically powerful maga in the Tribunal. Haughty and overbearing, she wants Durenmar and the Rhine restored to the first place in the Order, and so quietly favours the Ash Gild's war on the Norse wizards, which would draw mighty magi and loot to the Rhine. Brilliant in every Art, above all Rego and Imaginem; she wears a great cloak of white feathers enchanted with illusions, and there are theories about whom she has impersonated in it. Her familiar is the raven Kolkrabus.

Secrets
She sends Kolkrabus to spy on Dankmar and on others she takes for enemies, in breach of the Code.

andrus.name: Andrus
andrus.summary: Master of House Bonisagus, Colens Arcanorum and librarian of the Great Library, Murion's first filius, about forty years past his Gauntlet. Thin and balding with a perceptive, commanding stare, he decides who may use the library and which gifts it accepts, so he is unwise to annoy. His duties keep him at the covenant and away from his own research. Many see him as Murion's puppet; rumour says he is preparing to challenge for Archmage within ten years.

tandaline.name: Tandaline
tandaline.summary: Master of House Bonisagus, of the Trianoma lineage, Murion's closest confidante and her appointed Tenens Occultorum. Pale and slender, with eyes that shift colour hypnotically; a master of Muto and Auram for decades, she studies the air by turning herself into vapour. Politically Murion's ally, yet respected as a free thinker in her own right; she writes to many Bonisagus magi and uses those connections to punish anyone reported to have abused one of the House. Her apprentice is Petrus Virilis's Gifted son.

caecilius.name: Caecilius
caecilius.summary: Archmage of House Bonisagus, the most venerable magus of Durenmar, senior Quaesitor of the Rhine Tribunal and the greatest living exponent of Intellego. Appointed Quaesitor long ago, it is said unwillingly and out of duty when the Tribunal's Quaesitorial presence was thin; his research extends the investigative rituals of House Guernicus. Reluctant and slow to act, with ever more frequent Twilight episodes, he is nonetheless a brilliant investigator with a spotless record who has solved many Hermetic crimes, and he adjudicates at Tribunal. His familiar is a silver-coated wolf.

occultes.name: Occultes
occultes.summary:
Master of House Bonisagus, leader of the Linden Gild and figurehead of Durenmar's outward-looking faction, which would admit exotic magic; a sizeable minority of the House would rather have him as Primus. A colourful man who researches manuscripts and items of every kind, has made a small golem that serves in his lab, enchanted many texts and quills, and collects news of artifacts and strange practices from far away. He was librarian until the former Primus Avarret removed him. Murion tolerates and watches him, judging his ambitions modest and fearing a schism in the House if she moved against him.

Secrets
He knows the restricted texts and has quietly copied or moved the most interesting into his own sanctum, passing them to close allies whose research they suit.

ricardus_caespuus.name: Ricardus Caespuus
ricardus_caespuus.summary: Master of House Bonisagus, a recluse whose sanctum on the covenant's southern edge is a great building walled almost entirely in glass, thousands of lead-framed panes on timber beams, unlike anything else in the century. Inside is a Herbam laboratory full of exotic plants from which he cultivates several kinds of vis, much as others extract it. Earnest and friendly but understood by nobody; Murion's circle rate him little better than a hedge wizard and bear with him for his harvests and his steady gifts to the stores.

petrus_virilis.name: Petrus Virilis
petrus_virilis.summary:
Journeyman of House Bonisagus, an otherwise mediocre magus whose seed is Vim vis, whether by faerie gift or through the obsessive research into fertility and the Gift of his liberal-minded mater Susanna, now in Final Twilight. Tandaline talked him into an experiment that fathered a Gifted son on a serving maid, now her apprentice, and on Murion's orders he has fathered four more, all Gifted, and all sons when born at Durenmar because of Philippus Niger's Twilight scar. Averse to sex and ill at ease with women, he would keep his vis to himself, but the covenant deems his talent too valuable; interested young magae write to him.

Secrets
He plans to invent a longevity ritual that would probably leave him infertile; Murion would be furious. A maga wanting a Gifted child must offer more than seduction; he might instead fall for a peasant girl and plan a wedding in a nearby town.

winfrida.name: Winfrida
winfrida.summary: Journeyman of House Guernicus and Quaesitor, young, inexperienced and timid, admitted some years ago because a Guernicus must always be at Durenmar; she passed her Gauntlet in the Greater Alps. She would secretly rather live the research life of a Bonisagus. She and Tabanus may be the only two Guernicus in the Rhine; Murion is grooming and indoctrinating her, confusing her loyalties, and Tabanus thinks her weak.

gudrun_tigurina.name: Gudrun Tigurina
gudrun_tigurina.summary: Master of House Verditius and Artificer of Durenmar, the honorary post that crafts items for the covenant's glory. She lives in Verditius' Forge, the half-buried laboratory the Founder built when he came to study with Bonisagus.

xavier.name: Xavier
xavier.summary: Master of House Mercere, the only Gifted Mercere in the Rhine and the Tribunal's archivist. He oversees the Mercer House in the basement of the Tower of Trianoma, which serves the southern Tribunal, and is content that Horst of Fengheld leads the Rhine's Redcaps from the other Mercer House.

schadrit.name: Schadrit
schadrit.summary: Master of House Ex Miscellanea, co-founder and iron-handed ruler of Dankmar. Trained as a Bonisagus apprentice at Durenmar under Aschlaranda, expelled with her mistress a year before her Gauntlet and finished outside the House. A withered hag in a voluminous hooded black robe, her face a mass of wrinkles about a long mole-covered nose; her longevity ritual kept her alive but not her looks. An expert in Faerie Magic, taught by Orphedra, and perhaps its only practitioner outside House Merinita; malicious to the point of evil.

orphedra.name: Orphedra
orphedra.summary: Master of House Merinita and the covenant's link to the forest fae. Apprenticed at Irencillia a hundred and twenty years ago, she found it stifling and sought the primeval dark instead. Stick-thin, hair in a tight bun, angular, with unnaturally smooth skin and an air that makes the covenfolk's skin crawl. She revels in Faerie Magic, which she taught Schadrit, leans to the dark fae, works in illusion, cold, darkness and fear, cast the covenant's Shrouded Glen, and has a deal with the local bockmen to patrol its surroundings.

jiphella.name: Jiphella
jiphella.summary: Master of House Ex Miscellanea and master of Mentem, Schadrit's own daughter, conceived under a dark faerie charm long after her mother's longevity ritual, trained by her and wholly cowed by her. Immense and bloated, with lank greasy grey hair and a sickly orange left eye with a blood-red iris that bewitches with a glance; most of the covenfolk are under her spell and worship her. She was Dankmar's only delegate at the Tribunal of 1214, where she denied any part in St Georgen's fall.

larinda.name: Larinda
larinda.summary: Journeyman of House Ex Miscellanea, Jiphella's daughter and filia, conceived under the same charm. Pretty and sunny despite a cruel mother and a domineering grandmother, whom she obeys out of family duty. Her affinities are for the natural world, Animal, Herbam, Aquam and Auram, and she is becoming an expert brewer of potions. The rest of her traits are lost in the source.

daria_la_gris.name: Daria la Gris
daria_la_gris.summary: Master of House Tremere, co-leader of the Apple Gild and princeps of Triamore. Stern, uncompromising and politic, she has kept the Quaesitores at bay and champions the Lotharingian Tribunal, courting the covenants of Normandy. She has trained two apprentices.

remi_of_museau.name: Remi of Museau
remi_of_museau.summary: Master of House Jerbiton, a friendly, effusive polymath: scholar, fighter, hunter, musician and poet, mostly without recourse to magic, though he knows many useful spells.

sicero.name: Sicero
sicero.summary: Journeyman of House Tremere, newly Gauntleted filius of Goliard, a famed maga of Stonehenge, and admitted on her recommendation. He has yet to prove himself.

hygwald_veritas.name: Hygwald Veritas
hygwald_veritas.summary: Journeyman of House Tremere and devious co-founder of Waddenzee, an Englishman trained at Blackthorn in Stonehenge. Scrupulously honest with Quaesitores, whom he secretly longs to join, and arrogant to everyone else, he lies, cheats and steals whenever it serves. Well groomed, looking in his late thirties, dressed to show his wealth; a Mentem specialist, above all Rego Mentem, who leans heavily on Aura of Rightful Authority.

eric_ribecus.name: Eric Ribecus
eric_ribecus.summary: Journeyman of House Tytalus, co-founder of Waddenzee and its most committed pirate: a black-haired Dane from Ribe, dashing, charming and extroverted, with a swollen opinion of himself, who looks far younger than he is thanks to illusions and a good longevity ritual. A generalist favouring Aquam and Auram, he fights beside his men with a magical sword; his familiar is Aegir, a long-tailed skua. His younger cousin Estrid Danesson of Oculus Septentrionalis is his bitter enemy.

lucas_von_beck.name: Lucas von Beck
lucas_von_beck.summary: Journeyman of House Flambeau, son of a German altgraf whose family believes him dead; he keeps a nobleman's habits. Very tall and stocky, always in black, and since a Twilight his clothes fall to pieces when he casts too much. A short-tempered expert in Perdo who kills troublesome mundanes with Perdo Corpus; he has lately taken up necromancy, using the pirates' victims and the Pirates' Graveyards.

hachim_al_khalejj.name: Hachim al'Khalejj
hachim_al_khalejj.summary: Journeyman of House Criamon, a quiet, naive Muslim, filius of Hassan El-Megrayhi of Fengheld, who fell in with the pirates by chance. His astrology helps plan their raids. He dresses in stolen cream and blue silks and walks with a limp.

henri_de_tours.name: Henri de Tours
henri_de_tours.summary: Master of House Jerbiton, of the Apple Gild, and disceptator of Oculus Septentrionalis as its oldest remaining member. Corpulent, sociable and splendidly dressed, probably Lübeck's richest merchant and among the richest commoners in Germany, a respected administrator and diplomat who was apprenticed in Normandy and joined soon after the founding; he means his family to become a dynasty leading the covenant. A Mentem master who uses high-magnitude Mentem for subtlety, never force. His townhouse on the Holstenstrasse has shop and offices below, library and scriptorium above, then meeting rooms, dining hall and guest chambers, then the family's quarters, with three labs at the top for himself, Brunhilda and Gunhilda.

gunhilda_henrasdottir.name: Gunhilda Henrasdottir
gunhilda_henrasdottir.summary: Journeyman of House Jerbiton and of the Apple Gild, Henri's daughter and filia. Plump and over-sheltered, she specialises in housecraft and is married to Estrid Danesson.

estrid_danesson.name: Estrid Danesson
estrid_danesson.summary: Journeyman of House Ex Miscellanea and of the Apple Gild, a recent recruit and the second Scandinavian wizard the covenant has taken in. A man of Ribe who joined the Order late as a hedge wizard of sailing and weather, a flamboyant rogue whose sanctum and lab are aboard his ship; he gathers the covenant's vis around the Baltic and is married to Gunhilda. He is the younger cousin and bitter enemy of Eric Ribecus of Waddenzee; they have fought at sea, though no Wizard's War has been declared.

marcus_navicularius.name: Marcus Navicularius
marcus_navicularius.summary:
Master of House Verditius and of the Apple Gild, Lübeck's foremost shipwright: large and stern, with iron-grey hair and beard, owner of a shipyard that is also his workshop and lab, staffed by skilled craftsmen. A Terram master whose enchanting suits very large things such as ships and cannot work on anything smaller than a sword; he sells magical ships to covenants for vis and lost the Nebelkönigin to Waddenzee. He is designing the Baltic cog the Hanse will adopt.

Secrets
He secretly corresponds with Aelfhere, Waddenzee's shipwright.

carolus.name: Carolus
carolus.summary: Journeyman of House Jerbiton and of the Apple Gild, well meaning and scatterbrained, who poses as an eccentric scholar tutoring the citizens. A naive visit to Crintera to mend relations went wrong when Caprea of Bjornaer, a guest there, blinded his raven familiar as a spy; the real spy was Kolkrabus, Murion's familiar.

boris_of_novgorod.name: Boris of Novgorod
boris_of_novgorod.summary: Journeyman Redcap of House Mercere, not of the Apple Gild, a well-travelled, shrew-like Russian posing as an itinerant merchant who serves the northern Rhine and Novgorod. He owns the new Novgorod Inn at the north end of town, popular with Redcaps and Russian merchants, and hopes for Master rank within a couple of years so that it may become a Mercer House. He sells trinkets, trades books, items and vis, and gets Novgorod vis cheaply.

stentorius.name: Stentorius
stentorius.summary: Archmage of House Tremere, leader of the Oak Gild, authoritarian princeps of Fengheld and Tremere exarch of the Rhine, holding about three-fifths of the Tribunal's Tremere sigils, his filius's and the two Tremere of Triamore among them, while Severicus of Roznov holds the rest. Large and ageing well nearly a century past his Gauntlet, with a bushy iron-grey beard to his chest and a craggy nose; a famed master of Rego, able with most Forms, in showy deep-crimson robes covered in the symbols of Rego, the Forms and his House. His familiar of more than fifty years is Oswald, a hugely arrogant large grey cat in a jewelled gold pendant holding several uses of Aura of Rightful Authority among other effects, who believes he rules Fengheld if not the Tribunal; Murion's raven Kolkrabus taunts him at Durenmar for usurping her place at the head of the Oak Gild.

horst.name: Horst
horst.summary: Master of House Mercere, an un-Gifted Redcap, senior Redcap of the Rhine Tribunal and master of Fengheld's Mercer House, where many Redcaps rest between journeys. A famous and prolific author of high-quality books on a huge range of mundane subjects and on Magic Theory, the backbone of most Rhine apprenticeships; corpulent, with a near-encyclopaedic memory consulted at Tribunal on obscure points of Hermetic law. Wholly apolitical, so his knowledge of the Order's business is of no political use to Fengheld. He wrote the visitor's account of Durenmar.

eule.name: Eule
eule.summary:
Master of House Bjornaer with the honorary rank of Quaesitor from House Guernicus, retired from official duty; for many years she was the Rhine's only senior Quaesitor. Owl heartbeast, and with Caecilius of Durenmar and Schadrit of Dankmar one of the oldest magi in the Tribunal. Magi still come to her for her celebrated advice.

Secrets
Only her filius Günther Lupus suspects that she has passed into Final Twilight: she has not taken human shape for years and has not spoken for longer. Her wisdom is a fraud. An item hidden in the floor of her audience room casts a low-level, very high Penetration Perdo Mentem effect that calms the mind and strips emotion, Günther translates her hoots with a few leading prompts, and the calmed petitioners find their own answers and thank Eule.

peter_von_w_rzburg.name: Peter von Würzburg
peter_von_w_rzburg.summary: Master of House Verditius, a celebrated vintner and grape-grower within the Order and among the nobles of southern Saxony and Thuringia. Minor enchanted items let the vines on Fengheld's south slope thrive this far north, and he turns special varieties into wines that are Charged Items; his squirrel familiar is as industrious as he is, and the two are seen tying vines, testing the sweetness and fertilising. Usually the first magus a visitor meets, out among the grapes; he oversees the head vintner, the orchard keeper and the farm foreman.

dorana.name: Dorana
dorana.summary: Master of House Bonisagus, the leading maga in the Rhine of the lineage of Irmele filia Trianoma. Decades as a peregrinator before she settled at Fengheld taught her nearly every covenant and many magi of the Tribunal in detail; she argues for reason and peace in Fengheld's dealings and usually wins. She detests her Prima, Murion, pressing Stentorius to contest the Oak Gild and her close ally Occultes of Durenmar to contest the Primacy. A weather specialist, she manages the sun, rain and visitor-deterring fog that Fengheld's farms and privacy depend on; her latest apprentice Felecia has just passed her Gauntlet and gone travelling.

indulius.name: Indulius
indulius.summary: Master of House Flambeau and a feared hoplite, who hunts oath-breakers in an odd but effective pairing with Günther Lupus.

g_nther_lupus.name: Günther Lupus
g_nther_lupus.summary:
Magus of House Bjornaer (rank not given), Eule's filius, wolf heartbeast. He hunts oath-breakers with Indulius and attends his ancient parens.

Secrets
He is the author of the Eule fraud, keeping up the myth of her wisdom with a hidden Perdo Mentem item and his own translation of her hoots.

balastor.name: Balastor
balastor.summary: Journeyman of House Criamon whose philosophy matches the Hawthorn Gild. Born feral, he had a powerful vital spirit his master saw fade as he learned speech and human ways, and he now means to return himself, and others whether they consent or not, to that primal state, holding that enlightenment demands casting off the mundane. His magic releases suppressed emotion and behaviour, and a Warped Magic flaw gives his face a savage cast when he casts; a puckish troublemaker who loves humbling self-important mundanes.

beechleaf.name: Beechleaf
beechleaf.summary: Journeyman of House Merinita, fresh-faced, apprenticed at Irencillia by the Primus Handri and newly offered a place at Fengheld's main site, which makes him uneasy because he cannot see the political reason for it. Raised by a dryad, he understands faeries far better than people; his skin is faintly green and his bronze hair stirs in a wind nobody else feels.

rudolph.name: Rudolph
rudolph.summary: Magus of House Bonisagus (rank not given) and author of the plan to plant a Fengheld chapter inside Durenmar itself, which Fengheld backs cautiously and some of its seniors doubt. His membership of Fengheld is implied rather than stated.

clemens.name: Clemens
clemens.summary: Master of House Tremere, filius of Stentorius and Fengheld's most senior master, who runs its biggest chapter house. Where that chapter lies is left to the storyguide, perhaps near the player covenant; nothing else is given of him.

marguerite.name: Marguerite
marguerite.summary: Maga of House Flambeau (rank not given) who lives at Fengheld House, the covenant's most remote chapter: a simple fortified townhouse in Cherbourg in Normandy, outside the Rhine, owned by Sir Jozef of Poznan, a Polish-born crusader, and running a small trade with England and France. Stunningly beautiful and every bit as rude, she holds mundanes beneath her and never passes up a cutting remark.

wilhelm_weiss.name: Wilhelm Weiss
wilhelm_weiss.summary: Master of House Jerbiton and co-leader of the Apple Gild, who lives at the Rheingasse chapter in the centre of Cologne, where he and Garrinchus, both Gentle-Gifted, arrange Fengheld's supplies and mundane contacts very ably. He poses as a wealthy merchant.

garrinchus.name: Garrinchus
garrinchus.summary: Newly Gauntleted journeyman of House Ex Miscellanea and of the Apple Gild, living at the Rheingasse chapter in Cologne with Wilhelm Weiss, where the two Gentle-Gifted magi see to Fengheld's supplies and contacts. His master was a recognised expert in physick.

hassan_el_megrayhi.name: Hassan El-Megrayhi
hassan_el_megrayhi.summary: Master of House Criamon and astronomer, who lives at Turris Acontiarum, a solitary tower in the Kyffhäuser Mountains on the Saxon-Thuringian border, studying the stars with a single mute companion. He is parens of Hachim al'Khalejj of Waddenzee.

odorpes.name: Odorpes
odorpes.summary:
Maga of House Bjornaer (rank not given), filia of Urgen, Archmage of Crintera, and sole inhabitant of the Lusatia chapter, an idyllic house on a bend of the Spree in the March of Lusatia only ten miles from the agreed Novgorod border, whose founding caused the latest boundary dispute between the two Tribunals. Bear heartbeast, in which she spends most of her time, hibernating all winter; a poor member, accused by Fengheld at Tribunal more than once of neglecting her duties, but never punished hard for fear of her aggressive, powerful parens.

Secrets
She and Urgen are the two living magi of a hidden lineage of bear-heartbeast Bjornaer descending from the Founder herself; they harvest the Bears' Cave in the northern Harz.

signum_irruptus.name: Signum Irruptus
signum_irruptus.summary:
Master of House Criamon and leader of Heorot, whose magi serve the Ash Gild's chief interest.

He is consumed by the trolls of Zealand, which he holds to be the degenerate descendants of old gods, and his study of them has cost the covenant fourteen grogs and him his left arm. He carries on regardless.

theoderich_of_augsburg.name: Theoderich of Augsburg
theoderich_of_augsburg.summary:
Journeyman of House Jerbiton, formerly of Oculus Septentrionalis, and Heorot's historian.

A necromancer by method, he raises the ghosts of the dead and questions them about the past. It frustrates him that he has not yet found the remains of Hrothgar or of Beowulf, on whose ground the covenant is said to stand.

pancrestis_filius_occultes.name: Pancrestis filius Occultes
pancrestis_filius_occultes.summary:
Journeyman of House Bonisagus at Heorot, who means to meet a Norse wizard and learn that magic for the Order.

His parens Occultes is famous and his mentor, the Archmage Philippus Niger of Durenmar, has impressed on him how urgently the Order needs those secrets revealed. Yet a deep dread of the wilderness has so far kept him from setting foot in pagan Scandinavia.

urgen.name: Urgen
urgen.summary:
Archmagus of House Bjornaer, Senior Elder in the Seat of the Bear, leader of the Hawthorn Gild and Primus of the House from 1165 to 1203, through the Danish invasion. His heartbeast is a bear.

He is the most influential of the Wilderists, holding that the Order must check the swelling mundane population and that Bjornaer must enter Hermetic politics to do so. Twice in fifty years he has torn a powerful magus apart in Wizard War, and his age and his victories earn him respect; support for him grows the longer the occupation of Rügen lasts.

jon_arnsson.name: Jon Arnsson
jon_arnsson.summary:
Master of House Bjornaer and protector of Crintera in the Seat of the Stag since the Gathering of 1167, a year before the invasion. His heartbeast is a lion.

A devout Christian who regards Valdemar's Church-backed conquest as righteous, yet fiercely loyal to Crintera, he is a man of divided and conflicted loyalties whose theology any other Christian would call heresy. Gentle and hating violence, he accepts its necessity and, as protector, joins Wizard's Marches against Bjornaer when he can. The second eldest after Urgen, he is a fervent Harmonist.

phyllia.name: Phyllia
phyllia.summary:
Master of House Bjornaer in the Seat of the Eagle, who keeps the council informed about the Order. Her heartbeast is a polecat.

She travels widely and has contacts across the Tribunal and beyond, but is a notorious gossip, quite unable to keep a secret. A Harmonist.

ardea.name: Ardea
ardea.summary:
Master of House Bjornaer and leader of its rituals in the Seat of the Swan. Her heartbeast is a heron.

Quiet and contemplative, a famous seer and diviner with a hunger for magical knowledge worthy of a Bonisagus, she keeps her political opinions to herself because her word carries such weight, and sides with neither faction. She stages the re-enactments of old legends at the Gathering.

istvan_padas.name: Istvan Padas
istvan_padas.summary:
Master of House Bjornaer in the Seat of the Horse, which keeps track of Crintera's magi and of every Bjornaer. His heartbeast is a magnificent stallion.

The youngest and most wilful Elder, a man of action, he descends from a line of horse-shaped Bjornaer taken into the House from the invading Magyars in the Order's early days. A Wilderist, strongly backed by his lover Zora, priestess of Hertha. His predecessor in the Seat died trying to climb the Königstuhl.

caprea.name: Caprea
caprea.summary:
Maga of House Bjornaer, at present a guest of Crintera; her rank and age are not recorded.

She is using the covenant's library to finish a bestiary she means to present at the Tribunal of 1221. By accident she blinded the familiar of Carolus of Oculus Septentrionalis, who had come as a peace envoy, and so deepened the feud between the covenants.

handri.name: Handri
handri.summary:
Master of House Merinita and its Primus, who shares his plans with only a few trusted advisers.

Where his predecessor Vinaria talked politics with the other Primi, he gives himself to long private embassies into faerie lands, and is rumoured to have met survivors of House Diedne. Nobody admits to seeing him cast anything but the signature spell that earned him his Mastery; a magus for some sixty years, he trained Iacob and Beechleaf of Fengheld and seems never to have sought Archmage status. His caricature is Rosmert, the imperious Queen of Irencillia's fae.

Secrets
He conceived the scheme for a faerie religion on becoming Primus. He is secretly afraid of Vinaria and lets her do as she pleases.

vinaria.name: Vinaria
vinaria.summary:
Archmaga of House Merinita and its former Prima, who stepped down after Handri outmanoeuvred her.

She is said to have entered Faerie Twilight and returned seven years later apparently unchanged. Politically formidable through long councils with the other Primi, whose contacts she uses skilfully, she is strongest in the raw elemental Arts and always dressed in beautiful glamour. Her old caricature, the faerie king, passed to Handri, and mysteriously she has acquired no new one since her return.

Secrets
Handri senses a new inner strength in her, fears her and avoids her entirely.

glesig.name: Glesig
glesig.summary:
Master of House Merinita and the House's foremost expert on the fae beneath the earth, a Terram specialist.

Big-boned and plain, her hair turned by Twilight into threads of shining copper. Her caricature Humnel, an immense troll, has become her faerie familiar; he is protective and hates to hear her insulted.

iacob_filius_handri.name: Iacob filius Handri
iacob_filius_handri.summary:
Master of House Merinita, leader of the Elder Gild and, after Vinaria, the covenant's most politically active magus.

A Master of Mentem unusually young, he invents spells that plant thoughts and ideas in their targets. Tall, looking barely into his thirties, he charms with an almost hypnotic voice. His caricature Nestor, a white crow, travels with him.

Secrets
He runs Handri's secret project to found a religion in the fae's name: he is the Prophet Iacob of the God of Truth, known by his albino crow. He never shows magic to mundanes, and the Quaesitors would be deeply unhappy to learn of it.

gravis.name: Gravis
gravis.summary:
Journeyman of House Bonisagus, come to Irencillia to pursue a lifelong fascination with the fae.

Though his Faerie Lore outstrips many a Merinita's, he cannot grasp even the rudiments of Faerie Magic, which frustrates him without making him bitter; he keeps trying. Chubby and sunny, his caricature Danket is a grumpy, stick-thin, scowling dwarf.

richenda_spinosa.name: Richenda Spinosa
richenda_spinosa.summary:
Journeyman of House Flambeau, a Pole, and an atypical member of her House.

As an apprentice she showed a gift for fire that her master Indulius of Fengheld never knew came from a secret faerie heritage, for she descends from Kupala, a faerie lord who guards the Fire Flower in the Slavic lands. His bungling, as she sees it, scarred her Gift so that fire magic now comes very hard, and her natural Herbam talent and faerie blood made her a laughing-stock in her House. Angry, with a bent for thorn spells, she has sworn vengeance on her master and is not yet reconciled to her fae side. Her caricature Jennis is a male version of herself, from whom she learns.

igor_rastvan.name: Igor Rastvan
igor_rastvan.summary:
Archmagus of House Ex Miscellanea, of the Ash or Oak Gild like all Roznov's magi, high priest of Radegast and leader of Roznov Castle and its covenfolk.

Some eighty years past his Gauntlet and still hale, with black curly hair and a waist-length beard barely touched with grey, he always wears embroidered robes showing scenes of myth and his priestly rank. The filius of a founder and perhaps the only Archmage of his House, he draws on Slavic cursing traditions and is feared for killing from afar; many of his spells carry a non-Hermetic ritual element fed by the pagan ceremonies he leads, so that more worshippers mean more power. His ambition is dominion over all the Slavic lands united under Radegast, an obsession now so strong his filii fear Twilight has unhinged him.

severicus.name: Severicus
severicus.summary:
Master of House Tremere, of the Ash or Oak Gild like all Roznov's magi, and leader of Roznov Fort.

Very tall and thin, wholly bald with a neat greying beard, a noted master of Terram who detests change of every kind. He holds his own sigil, as only he and Stentorius of Fengheld do among the Rhine's Tremere, and controls about two-fifths of the others.

tabanus.name: Tabanus
tabanus.summary: Quaesitor of House Guernicus, a peregrinator sent to the Rhine about ten years ago because the House thought its presence here weak. His evidence once Marched a Hawthorn Gild magus on what many called a technicality, and he is unpopular, that gild especially; he moves from covenant to covenant every few years, preferring young covenants that will not try to browbeat him. He lately left Triamore. With Winfrida of Durenmar he may be one of only two Guernicus in the Tribunal.
